title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Gloucester
Working Pattern: Hybrid

A great opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join a busy finance team based in central Gloucester.

The role will support the wider finance function across Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, including processing invoices, managing payments, reconciliations and dealing with supplier and customer queries.

Key Responsibilities:
- Supporting day-to-day AP and AR processes
- Processing invoices and payments
- Account and bank reconciliations
- Managing supplier and customer queries
- Supporting the wider finance team with general duties

About You:
- Previous AP and/or AR experience
- Good attention to detail
- Confident working with Excel and finance systems
- Organised and able to manage deadlines
- Good communication skills

Salary: 26,000- 27,000 + hybrid working.

title: People Services Coordinator
description:
About the Role:
We are looking for an organised, proactive and customer-focused People Services Coordinator to join our HR team in Gloucester. This is a varied role where you'll support employees throughout their journey with the business, from joining and contractual changes through to payroll, benefits, family
leave and leaving processes.

Safran - Here, we craft excellence together.

At Safran, excellence is a journey - and we'd love you to be a part of it. As a trusted global leader in aerospace, defence, and space, we are proud to be a company where diversity, innovation, and opportunity come together to shape a sustainable future where we can all succeed together through a shared vision.

Key Responsibilities:
Maintain accurate HR data to support payroll processing, ensuring all employee changes are submitted within required timelines.
Liaise with payroll providers and internal stakeholders to resolve routine payroll queries.
Administer employee benefits, including enrolment, amendments and leaver processes, ensuring data accuracy across systems.
Coordinate the PEGI share scheme process, including reporting, payroll deductions, stakeholder liaison and campaign administration.
Produce payroll-related reports and support audit and reconciliation activities.
Support annual salary review, profit share and bonus administration.
Provide administrative support for employee relations processes, including meeting coordination, documentation and note-taking.
Support HR colleagues and managers by coordinating activities and ensuring adherence to agreed processes.
Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate HR specialist.
Build effective relationships with employees, managers and stakeholders.
Support onboarding activities, including HR induction delivery.
Deliver administrative support across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, contractual changes and offboarding.
Generate and issue employment-related documentation in line with company policies.
Administer family-friendly, statutory leave and holiday monitoring processes, escalating concerns where appropriate.
Maintain accurate employee data within HR systems.
Coordinate contractor administration activities.
Perform absence data validation checks and resolve discrepancies with managers.
Identify and escalate sponsored worker cases requiring updates through immigration processes.
Identify and recommend improvements to HR processes, systems and documentation.
Support process improvement and digitalisation initiatives.
Maintain HR templates, guidance materials and knowledge resources.
Share insights from recurring queries or issues to improve service delivery.
Process invoices, monitor purchase orders and maintain accurate records.
Liaise with external providers to support HR services.

What You'll Bring:
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
Confidence using HR systems, data and Microsoft 365 applications.
Good Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables and formulas.
A professional, approachable and customer-focused manner.
The ability to work independently, take ownership and escalate issues when appropriate.
A proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
A sound understanding of UK employment legislation relevant to HR administration.
Experience of advanced Excel, HR compliance activities or working within an international organisation would be advantageous.
We know that some candidates may be put off applying for jobs where they don't meet 100% of the criteria outlined in the advert. We encourage anybody to apply if you can demonstrate a variety of skills and experience relevant to the requirements of this role. Please let us know if you would like to discuss any reasonable adjustments to the hiring process that may better facilitate your participation.
We celebrate our differences and believe they make us stronger. We know that a fulfilling work environment is a key driver for innovative ideas and team success.

title: Purchase Ledger
description:
Purchase ledger clerk/Accounts Assistant required for a 6 month contract to take charge of invoicing, payments and reconciliations ensuring the smooth flow of financial transactions across the business.
The role is based in Gloucestershire GL56 for 5 days a week with the option to work from home once a week after a successful training period.

We are looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Clerk with strong Excel skills to support the efficient running of the purchase ledger function. The ideal candidate will be highly analytical, detail-focused, and confident handling large datasets.

Key Responsibilities:
Processing high volumes of purchase invoices accurately and efficiently
Matching, batching, and coding invoices to the correct accounts
Performing supplier statement reconciliations and resolving discrepancies
Managing supplier queries in a timely and professional manner
Preparing and assisting with weekly/monthly payment runs
Maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records
Using Excel to analyse data, track invoices, and support reporting
Identifying process improvements and increasing efficiency within AP

Excel & Technical Requirements:
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including:
Pivot tables
VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP
Data filtering and sorting
Basic formulas (SUMIF, COUNTIF, etc.)
Experience working with accounting systems (e.g., Sage, Xero, or similar)
Ability to manage and reconcile large volumes of data

Skills & Experience:
Proven experience in an Accounts Payable or Purchase Ledger role
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Strong organisational and time management skills
Good communication skills for liaising with suppliers and internal teams
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

title: Receptionist
description:
Part-Time Receptionist

Part time receptionist - temporary position with the possibility to go permanent

12.71 per hour, 20-25 hours per week

AM Shift: 8:00am - 1:15pm / PM Shift: 1:30pm - 6:30pm

Location - Gloucester

Are you an organised, friendly and professional individual with previous reception or administration experience? We are currently recruiting for a Part-Time Receptionist to join a busy and welcoming GP practice based in Gloucester.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team within a highly respected healthcare environment, with the possibility of securing a permanent position.

About the Role

Working as part of a reception team of approximately five people, you will be supporting a busy GP surgery serving around 5,000 patients. This is a varied role that requires excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Key Responsibilities
- Greeting patients and visitors in a friendly and professional manner
- Registering and maintaining new patient records
- Opening, sorting and distributing incoming post
- Managing telephone enquiries and directing calls appropriately
- Providing general administrative support to the practice team
- Ensuring patient information is handled confidentially and accurately

The Ideal Candidate
- Previous reception or administration experience is essential
- Confident using computers and learning new systems
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Friendly, approachable and professional manner
- Able to work efficiently in a busy environment
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Flexible and reliable with a positive attitude

If you enjoy working with people and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to be considered for this exciting opportunity, send your CV to (url removed)

Travail Employment Group Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
Thanks for your application. Due to the high level of responses we are currently receiving, whilst we endeavour to contact everyone, sometimes we are unable to. If you have not heard from us within 10 working days of making your application, please assume that you have been unsuccessful on this occasion.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Our client, a group of market-leading brands deliver engineered water solutions such as pumps, booster sets, flow meter chambers and pressurisation units to customers across the UK and beyond. Based in Gloucester, they are now looking for a Salesforce Administrator to join their team.

As Salesforce Administrator you will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, configuration and ongoing development of the Group's Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud) across their trading entities. Sitting within Group IT and reporting to the Head of IT, the role brings Salesforce capability in-house.

Please note- this role is based in Gloucester, with occasional travel to Henley, Colchester and Redditch

Key Responsibilities

Build, Automation & Development (Primary Focus)
- Design, build, test and maintain automation using Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled and autolaunched), validation rules, approval processes, and assignment and escalation rules.
- Configure and make targeted change amendments; commission bespoke development externally only where genuinely warranted.
- Investigate and resolve issues. Identifying root cause rather than symptom.

Platform Administration & Configuration
- Administer and configure Salesforce Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud environments.
- Manage users, roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and data access across clouds, applying least-privilege principles.
- Maintain reports, dashboards, list views and analytics used by commercial and marketing teams.

Release, Change & Environment Management
- Operate within Group IT change control: raise, document and obtain approval for changes in line with FWG IT policy, with defined rollback plans for higher-risk work.

Support & Incident Management
- Act as the escalation point for Salesforce incidents and service requests, working within Group IT service management processes and agreed response expectations.
- Triage, prioritise and resolve user issues, with clear criteria for the small number of cases that warrant escalation to Salesforce Support or an external partner.
- Maintain a prioritised backlog of enhancements and defects, visible to IT leadership and business stakeholders.
- Produce and maintain user guidance and deliver training to improve adoption and reduce avoidable demand.

Stakeholder, Vendor & People
- Work directly with commercial and marketing stakeholders across the Group's entities to gather requirements and translate them into scalable solutions - including the ability to challenge change that would damage the platform.

Administrative / Other
- Ensure Salesforce documentation, configuration records and process maps are maintained and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
- Any other duty that may reasonably be required by the Head of IT or IT Director.

Requirements
- Proven experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
- Strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud; hands-on experience of Marketing Cloud.
- Excellent communication skills and a business-focused mindset; able to work with non-technical stakeholders and technical IT colleagues alike.
- Comfortable operating as the in-house expert, working to IT governance, change control and documentation standards.
- Hands-on experience in a Salesforce greenfield implementation.
- Marketing Cloud Email Specialist, Administrator or Consultant certification.
- Experience of Salesforce integration with Sage 200 or EFACS, or comparable ERP integration.
- Familiarity with Pardot / Account Engagement, Tableau, CPQ or Salesforce-integrated applications.
- Experience in a multi-site or multi-entity business environment.
- Experience mentoring or supporting the development of a junior administrator.

Benefits

Monday- Friday 8am-5pm
Salary - £32,000
